## Plugin reference

- Description: The agents' part of the menu-bar panel's status line (MenuBar.Status 'agents'): from useConversations(), partitioned like the agent manager's home — working or starting → 'N agents working', waiting → 'N need you' — with attention while any agent waits on the user, which lights the menu-bar icon's dot.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `MenuBar.Status` "Agents"
  - Uses:
    - `conversations.useConversations`
    - `menu-bar.MenuBar`
